scripts.dev:all: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('.next',{recursive:true,force:true})" && concurrently -k -n api,web "cd ../backend && .venv\Scripts\python -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000" "next dev -p 3000"
scripts.prod:all: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('.next-prod',{recursive:true,force:true})" && next build && concurrently -k -n api,web "cd ../backend && .venv\Scripts\python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000" "next start -p 3000"
